_comment: Example. Copy into the repo and own it.
bkit install does not write this file and does not overwrite a copy.
Pure-builder allowlist for bkit-graph-eager.py. The list only says what is safe.
A call at module scope is reported unless something here declares it pure.
Pure means evaluating it allocates a value and touches nothing else.
pure: exact callee. pure_prefixes: callee starts with this. pure_methods: callee ends with this. pure_receivers: text before the last dot.
min_downstream: rows below this many downstream files stay in the JSON report and out of docs/capabilities.md.
